id: title:DanielVisca:wire the heatmap display type to the histogram query in the viewer

review.posthog_relevance: Adds heatmap display capability and histogram query support to the metrics viewer, including eligibility checks and state management for saved queries.
review.reason: The change introduces the heatmap display type and histogram query node into the metrics viewer, including eligibility checks, state fields, and fallback behavior. While the actual heatmap rendering and query execution implementation are not present in this chunk, the supporting infrastructure and eligibility guards are established. This represents a substantive, bounded capability

The score is assigned based on the visible frontend state and eligibility checks, not the complete end-to-end functionality.

observations.posthog_connection: Adds a guard to switch display type back to line chart when the query becomes ineligible for heatmap, preventing mismatched display and saved query.
